capabilities: Show each checklist task in a base's notes as its own row with dates, priority, tags and source note
Tick tasks from the view and write the change back to the source line
Show per-note task progress counts in a second view
Sort, filter and group tasks by date, note, heading or tag
Edit due dates, move tasks to today and complete tasks in bulk (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free tier caps views at 200 tasks/notes; Pro ($5/month or $15 once via GitHub Sponsors) removes the limit and adds groups, due-date editing, bulk actions and recurring tasks. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+ with the Bases core plugin enabled. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and sends no vault data.
intentEvidence: Bases Task Rows adds two views to Bases.
problem: Bases selects notes but has no built-in view that surfaces individual checklist tasks as rows or lets you complete them from the base.

relations.evidence: it also adds a done date (✅ 2026-10-10 or [completion:: 2026-10-10]), like the Tasks plugin

summary: Bases plugin that shows each checklist task in a base's notes as its own row, with dates, tags and progress views, and ticks tasks from the view.
